correctness.rationale: Correctness PASS: The same random valuation is used in both modalities, and each bad R-class is exactly a block included in the union F of S-classes with no marked atom. The Stam distribution is exactly uniform by the Dobinski factorial sum. Its mean/variance concentration gives n/M-W(n)->0. The one-/two-point formulas for F indicators retain their dependence, showing |F|/M_S->exp(-c). Given this effective set and independent Stam M_R, the exact inclusion-exclusion factorial-moment identity tends to (exp(exp(-c))-1)^k. Joint size-specific factorial moments tend to products of exp(-cj)/j!. Both Poisson conclusions and the zero-obstruction modal probability follow. A checker extracted from this package exhaustively verifies all finite modal equivalences through n=4 and Bell-Stirling formulas through n=5; finite checks are not substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Value PASS: Nested possibility is the natural two-agent existential reachability operation on equivalence knowledge classes. Its all-world failure is a sharp obstruction whose effective-set size is controlled by a second random partition. The theorem identifies the qualitatively new log-log/log marking threshold, a nontrivial double-exponential critical profile, and the full fixed-size independent-Poisson obstruction spectrum, instead of an arbitrary finite enumeration or a routine constant improvement. It supplies a concrete bridge between epistemic modal formula satisfaction and random partition occupancy with a reusable conditional moment identity.
